PerturbationFamily.description:
Family of perturbation applied to stress-test a system.

A perturbation family names *how* the world is disturbed; concrete
parameters live in :class:`iso_obs_schemas.core.PerturbationSpec`.
PerturbationFamily.title: PerturbationFamily

description:
A single perturbation applied within a scenario.

Perturbations are embedded value objects (not standalone persisted entities),
so they carry no id. They describe *how* the world is disturbed and *when*.

end_step.description: Last step the perturbation is active (inclusive).
end_step.title: End Step

name.description: Short label for this perturbation instance.
name.title: Name

parameters.description: Family-specific parameters, e.g. noise scale or force.
parameters.title: Parameters

start_step.description: First step the perturbation is active (inclusive).
start_step.title: Start Step

title: PerturbationSpec
